title: Rewind phase restores a work head
statement: For all natural numbers $c,C,q$, every Boolean word $x$, every work-head position function $h\colon\{0,\ldots,c\}\to\mathbb Z$, every Boolean output word $o$, every tape index $i\in\{0,\ldots,c\}$, and every $j\le q$, starting in state $\mathrm{rewind}(i)$ with head positions obtained from $h$ by setting position $i$ to $j-1$ leads after $j+1$ steps to state $\mathrm{advance}(i+1)$, with position $i$ reset to $0$ and all other head positions as in $h$, and with output still $o$.
